description: This PHP source file defines the SocialMediaAuthenticationService class within the OrangeHRM system. It facilitates social media-based authentication, particularly using OpenID Connect, and manages user identities and OAuth flows. The class interacts with data access objects (DAOs), external providers, and authentication services to enable social media login functionalities.

classes.name: SocialMediaAuthenticationService
classes.description: Service class that handles social media authentication processes, including initiating OIDC authentication flows, managing user identities, and checking if social media authentication is enabled within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAuthProviderDao
methods.description: Returns the instance of AuthProviderDao, initializing it if not already set.

methods.name: getUserDao
methods.description: Returns the instance of UserDao, initializing it if not already set.

methods.name: initiateAuthentication
methods.description: Creates and configures an OpenIDConnectClient for authenticating against a specified provider with given scope and redirect URL.

methods.name: getRedirectURL
methods.description: Generates the URL to which users are redirected for the authentication process.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Returns the scope string used in OAuth/OIDC requests (default: 'email').

methods.name: getSystemUsers
methods.description: Searches for system users matching the provided user credentials.

methods.name: getUserForAuthenticate
methods.description: Retrieves and validates a User object based on provided credentials, throwing exceptions if not found, disabled, or terminated.

methods.name: setOIDCUserIdentity
methods.description: Associates a User with an OpenIdProvider by creating a new OpenIdUserIdentity record.

methods.name: handleOIDCAuthentication
methods.description: Sets authentication credentials for a given user, completing the login process via OIDC.

methods.name: isSocialMediaAuthEnable
methods.description: Checks whether social media authentication providers are enabled and available.
